## Où j'en suis
The workflow shifted from HubSpot webhooks to a 15-minute CRM polling job due to private app authentication limits. PR #409 remains open; it implements windowed pagination to bypass the 10k result cap and exclusively syncs active companies (ARR > 0). Auto-squash merge was triggered, but background CI flagged a failure in `test_admin_accounts.py` because the test fixture still references a trial account now excluded by the filter.

- [en-cours] Patch the e2e fixture in `tests/e2e/test_admin_accounts.py` to align expected row counts with the new ARR filter so CI clears.
- [prochaine-étape] Coordinate with Noa to inject the `HUBSPOT_TOKEN` into AWS Secrets Manager for staging and production.
- [décision] Abandon the webhook PR and adopt scheduled polling instead (source: t04)
- [décision] Restrict the sync query to companies with positive ARR, discarding all trials (source: t10)
- [décision] Raise PR #409 with automated squash merging enabled (source: t12)
